symptom: A statement after `return` (or break/continue/join/raise error, an if/else returning on both sides, or a `while true` with no break) passed `check`, exec wrote it, and mx check refused the flow with CE0104, CE0105 or CE0709
cause: No check modelled reachability; the builder wires the dead statement out of an End/Break/Continue/Error event or a merge-bound path anyway
insight: The CE code depends on what the dead statement hangs off, not on the cause: right after a return inside an if it is CE0709 (the flow leaves an end event), after a loop or if/else it is CE0104 (+CE0105 if last) — so the cheatsheet's 'CE0104 = code after RETURN' sent readers to the wrong code for the commonest shape. mx check's console output carries no document name; `mx check -j out.json` does (locations[].document-name), which is what makes one project with N shapes one 25 s measurement instead of N. A `merge` restarts reachability (a join can land there), and an enum split whose cases all return does make the next statement CE0104 but alongside CE0079 — the fix there is the empty outcome, so it is deliberately not reported as dead code. A break inside a case or handler body of a `while true` builds as something else entirely (CE0068 / CE0644), so the break search is widened only in the direction that suppresses a report.
